notes: Initial ore recovered by the 2026-07-19 skills.sh value-mining campaign. These are prior-research leads, not current production approvals.

sources.title: Skills.sh value-mining research snapshot
sources.notes: Evidence cutoff 2026-07-19; refresh volatile claims before spending or adoption.

candidates.title: Microsoft Waza
candidates.summary: Evaluation machinery with baselines, repeated and multi-model trials, deterministic and behavioral graders, trigger checks, token accounting, snapshots, and CI output.

candidates.title: agent-browser
candidates.summary: Browser automation primitive with accessibility references, diffs, traces, network inspection, JSON output, encrypted auth, and containment controls.

candidates.title: Webwright
candidates.summary: Turns completed browser tasks into rerunnable Python programs and parameterized operational procedures.

candidates.title: Impeccable
candidates.summary: Design doctrine, persistent context, visual iteration, and deterministic no-model anti-pattern detectors.

candidates.title: HyperFrames
candidates.summary: Local deterministic HTML-to-MP4 production engine with scaffold, preview, lint, inspect, and render workflow.

candidates.title: Playwright CLI
candidates.summary: Concise browser commands intended to reduce agent context cost on Playwright-governed work.

candidates.title: Firecrawl CLI
candidates.summary: Search, scrape, crawl, extraction, hosted browser work, and monitoring with credit, custody, and provider-dependence tradeoffs.

candidates.title: MarketingSkills
candidates.summary: Broad marketing taxonomy and shared product-context material useful for capability gap analysis and selective quarrying.

candidates.title: Anthropic skill-creator
candidates.summary: Paired with-and-without-skill runs, human review viewer, assertions, and token and time aggregation.

candidates.title: Vercel agent-skills
candidates.summary: Maker-authored React, Next.js, composition, and design rules suitable as version-bound technical references.
